notes.contract_payoff_model: AI factions use influence transfer at CONTRACT_INFLUENCE_RATE=0.1 (credits * 0.1 = influence) via InfluenceManager.addLump(winnerId, influence, InfluenceSource.CONTRACT_PAYOFF). Player faction receives literal credits via CargoAPI.getCredits().add(pay). The real InfluenceManager.addLump(String, float, InfluenceSource) method was confirmed at InfluenceManager.java:48.
notes.influence_source_addition: Added CONTRACT_PAYOFF to InfluenceSource enum at end (preserves ordinals). Existing CONTRACT entry remained; CONTRACT_PAYOFF is distinct (payoff vs. cost-to-issue).
notes.ai_demand_issuance_hook: Wired in DiplomaticExecutor.executeDiplomaticAction() switch — added cases PRESS_GRIEVANCE and EXPLOIT_WEAKNESS both calling issueAIDemand(). The PRD correctly noted these goal types were silently dropped in the default branch. PRESS_GRIEVANCE maps archetype to TRIBUTE_CREDITS (military/territorial) or BREAK_ALLIANCE (ideological). EXPLOIT_WEAKNESS prefers CEDE_MARKET if target has a market, else TRIBUTE_CREDITS. Both gate on canIssueDemand() cooldown (30-day default) and pending-demand spam guard (>=2 blocks issuance).
notes.covert_dispatch_limitation: Nex AgentIntel.getAgent() returns PersonAPI which has no setTarget/setAction methods. No public Nex API exists to programmatically queue a covert action from outside. dispatchContractAction() confirms the agent exists and the def is registered, then logs the intent. Influence is still transferred; actual Nex covert launch is deferred pending a public API. TODO: wire when Nex exposes CovertOpsManager.queueActionForAgent() or similar.
notes.coalition_vote_resolution: CoalitionGovernance.advanceDay() now resolves expired pending votes using real member count from AgreementManager.getCoalitionMembersFor(proposerFactionId). DECLARE_WAR fires per-member war declarations. MAKE_PEACE fires NexDiplomacyBridge.firePeaceTreaty(). ADD_MEMBER/KICK_MEMBER/DISSOLVE log results but full agreement teardown is deferred to avoid circular dependency on AgreementManager from CoalitionGovernance.
notes.fireCoalitionWarDeclaration_absent: NexDiplomacyBridge.fireCoalitionWarDeclaration() does not exist. DECLARE_WAR is handled by iterating members and calling DiplomacyManager.createDiplomacyEvent(member, target, 'declare_war', null) per member.
notes.resolve_string_bypass: CoalitionVote.resolve(String) now throws UnsupportedOperationException. Grep confirmed zero external callers.
notes.propose_vote_wiring: Option A chosen: AgreementManager.createAgreement() COALITION path now proposes an ADD_MEMBER vote when members.size() > 2 (upgrade path). Both proposing parties cast immediate YEA votes. Added AgreementManager.getCoalitionMembersFor(String) single-faction overload delegating to getCoalitionMembers(factionId, factionId).
notes.smoke_runcode: auditDemandContractVote() added to Nex4xDebugCommand. Tests: (1) demand issue+accept, (2) contract bid+complete+influence delta, (3) coalition vote resolve with quorum pass, (4) quorum enforcement with 0 votes vs 4 members. Also added auditDemands(), auditContracts(), auditVotes() audit methods.
